source.title: The mid first-bar follow on NQ (Claude, 2026-10-20): JJ's opening-candle idea at the engine's mid pass

entry.words: The first 15-minute bar of the engine's midday pass (11:00-11:15 ET) closes up: market long at 11:15; closes down: short. Stop 30 points, target 30 points (1:1), once a day, flat at the pass's end (13:30). The same first-bar rule at the only other session boundary the engine has; no prior read.
